advisory.finding: The IfExp/BoolOp branch-union resolution route — explicitly named as binding route #5 in the module docstring (line 18) and implemented at scripts/check_config_reads.py:301-308 — has no test. The parametrized `test_every_real_receiver_shape_counts_as_a_read` covers six shapes, none of which is a conditional-expression or boolean-op receiver, so a regression that broke the branch-union logic (e.g. resolving only one branch, or returning empty) would not be caught.

advisory.suggested_fix: Extend the parametrization with e.g. `("ifexp", "def f(a: SectionConfig, b: SectionConfig, c):\n    return (a if c else b).ghost_knob\n")` and a BoolOp analogue.
